summary: Iteration 2: Backend (pytest, 11 tests) and frontend (Playwright) verification of new features — teacher auth/change-password, teacher credentials CRUD, teacher photo public access, documents upload/list/delete/auth-gated download, exports archived, notify (skipped), department mode toggle, brute-force lockout. Admin desktop workspace, mobile day-cards + edit modal, teacher-login flow, and public teacher portal all pass.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~566 lines and mixes many concerns (auth, files, documents, notifications, timetable, config, entities, exports). Consider splitting into routers/modules for maintainability.

LoginInput enforces password min_length=6 which returns 422 for shorter inputs before hitting rate-limit logic — bots probing with short passwords bypass the failure counter. Consider counting 422s toward lockout too, or lower min_length on login.
Cookie samesite='none' + secure is correct for cross-origin preview; document this requirement for production deployment.

Run pytest with env exported: `export $(grep -v '^#' /app/frontend/.env | xargs) && pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v`. Notify/exports depend on active demo timetable; do NOT reset demo. Public /api/files/{id} for teacher photos verified without cookie. Documents require admin cookie for download (401 without).
